title: FACE-DEC
description: FACE-DEC is an OPM-MEG (optically pumped magnetometer magnetoencephalography) dataset for studying face perception through multivariate decoding and representational similarity analysis. The release includes analysis code for preprocessing (face_1_prep), decoding (face_2_dec), RSA (face_3_rsa), statistics (face_4_stat), and Bayesian model selection (face_6_bayes.m), with a main entry script (face_0_main). Individual facial point clouds and structural MRIs were not collected because optical scanning equipment was unavailable, so all analyses were performed at the whole-brain sensor level. Data collection was approved by the Institutional Review Board of Peking University.
methods_description: Data were acquired with an OPM-MEG system and stored in an in-house LabVIEW format, then converted to FIF. Sensor coordinates were approximated from the Elekta layout and do not reflect actual sensor positions; they are used only for topographic visualization. No structural MRI or facial point clouds were collected.
